author: root/coordinator

checks.description: Prove exact U-Boot recovery dispatch and unarmed/default fallback with explicit one-shot marker and payload binding.
Prove ordered durable staging, exact target/source admission and fail-closed prewrite/postopen interruption semantics without automatic retry.
Exercise actual RAM writer/controller success, refusal and normal return in disposable QEMU; default SD/A-B paths stay unchanged.
Read-only physical recovery handoff captures live identity, marker/fallback and return without whole-device target open.
Separately reviewed H12 full physical write/readback/next boot with exact target, artifact and recovery.

constraints.text: Demonstrate recovery selection with the exact compiled dispatcher and RAUC bootmeth across valid, exhausted, corrupt and redundant environment states. An unarmed boot and any absent, malformed or mismatched marker must retain the existing recovery UI.

Prove that staging, boot-policy arming, marker consumption and claim acquisition are ordered and durable. Every prewrite interruption must leave a usable boot or recovery path; every uncertain postopen result must remain stopped without automatic retry.

Measure recovery-partition space and boot memory addresses; exercise the actual RAM writer and one-shot controller in QEMU through full readback and normal boot of an image that replaces the temporary recovery script and environment.

Keep read-only physical handoff and the later attended full-image write separate under H12. Bind each to the current target, exact artifact and recovery plan, with independent high-consequence review and applicable owner authorization before a physical boot-policy change or write.

decision.rationale: The owner's standing goal supports delegated offline research toward a reflash of the installed eMMC with no physical action per normal write. It does not require a new owner decision merely to investigate this route. Commit b846d2a proposes a useful step beyond the approved SD writer, but its boot transition is materially unproven. The compiled dispatcher in configs/host-os/sv08-default.env and its source in boot-dispatch.cmd run RAUC bootflow first and load partition 5 recovery.scr only after bootflow returns and no eligible attempt causes a reset. The observed v5 A-slot boot does not prove that zeroed counters, redundant environment updates, or malformed states select recovery as proposed. The current recovery.scr generated by scripts/assemble_board_diagnostic.py boots the independent UI directly; replacing it with a marker-sensitive script changes a recovery path whose default behavior must be preserved. The proposal also leaves the durable marker-consumption and prewrite interruption protocol, exact RAM load and MMC mapping, recovery-partition space, and boot after a complete image replaces the temporary script and environment to be demonstrated. Decision 0018 authorizes a bounded offline prototype but explicitly grants no installed boot-policy modification or physical write. H12 and an immediate independent high-consequence review remain gates for physical action. Exit evidence is an exact U-Boot sandbox trace for valid and exhausted RAUC states and both redundant environment outcomes; fault-injected staging and marker-consumption tests proving fallback before target open and no automatic retry after it; a measured recovery-partition and RAM-address budget; and QEMU proof that the actual handoff writes, reads back, and boots the replacement image's normal slot while the unarmed recovery UI remains available. If that evidence requires changing accepted recovery policy or expanding physical authority, seek an owner decision before doing so. This review made no hardware contact or edits.
